'''Luka Jović''' ({{lang-sr-Cyrl|Лука Јовић}}; born 23 December 1997) is a Serbian professional [[Association football|footballer]] who plays as a [[Forward (association football)|striker]] for [[Super League Greece]] club [[AEK Athens F.C.|AEK Athens]] and the [[Serbia national football team|Serbia national team]].

He began his youth career at [[Red Star Belgrade]] before making his senior debut in May 2014. He then had stints at [[S.L. Benfica|Benfica]], [[Eintracht Frankfurt]], [[Real Madrid]], [[ACF Fiorentina|Fiorentina]], and [[AC Milan]], before signing for AEK Athens in 2025. Internationally, Jović has represented Serbia since 2018, earning over 45 caps and scoring 11 goals, and has played in major tournaments including the 2018 and 2022 [[FIFA World Cup]]s and [[UEFA Euro 2024]].

==Early life==
Jović was born in [[Loznica]], FR Yugoslavia.<ref name="Loznica ref">{{cite web |author=Blic |author-link=Blic |date=10 March 2019 |title=EVROPSKI HIT Luka Jović za Blicsport: Roditelji su dali i poslednji dinar da bih uspeo |work=Blic.rs |url=https://sport.blic.rs/fudbal/evropski-hit-luka-jovic-za-blicsport-roditelji-su-dali-i-poslednji-dinar-da-bih-uspeo/l983nsx |access-date=29 March 2021 |language=sr |archive-date=4 July 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210704065054/https://sport.blic.rs/fudbal/evropski-hit-luka-jovic-za-blicsport-roditelji-su-dali-i-poslednji-dinar-da-bih-uspeo/l983nsx |url-status=live }}</ref> He was raised in the small village of Batar near [[Bijeljina]], [[Republika Srpska]], to Serbian parents Milan and Svetlana Jović.<ref name="Bleacher ref">{{cite web |url=https://bleacherreport.com/articles/2825629-luka-jovic-from-doughnut-guzzling-teen-to-one-of-europes-most-wanted-strikers |author=Bleacher Report |author-link=Bleacher Report |title=Luka Jovic: From Doughnut-Guzzling Teen to One of Europe's Most Wanted Strikers |website=[[Bleacher Report]] |accessdate=29 March 2021 |date=14 March 2019 |language=English |archive-date=17 January 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210117215908/https://bleacherreport.com/articles/2825629-luka-jovic-from-doughnut-guzzling-teen-to-one-of-europes-most-wanted-strikers |url-status=live }}</ref> At the age of five, he started playing football in Loznica, where he was spotted in 2004 and offered to play in Mini Maxi, a development league for kids aged between 4 and 12 in [[Belgrade]]. After just one game where Jović scored three goals, his father was offered €50 for each game he played and 2,000 [[Bosnia and Herzegovina dinar|dinars]] for travelling costs from Batar to Belgrade. At one of those games he was scouted by Toma Milićević, [[Red Star Belgrade|Red Star]]'s scout who invited him to trial with [[Red Star Belgrade]].<ref name="Cudo">{{cite web |date=27 December 2013 |title=Mozzart Sport: ''Čudesan slučaj Luke Jovića, ili – Kako je klinac koji je spavao u gepeku stigao do velike pozornice'' |url=http://www.mozzartsport.com/vesti/cudesan-slucaj-luke-jovica-ili-kako-je-klinac-koji-je-spavao-u-gepeku-stigao-do-velike-pozornice/67871 |language=sr |access-date=13 May 2015 |archive-date=31 March 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170331045015/http://www.mozzartsport.com/vesti/cudesan-slucaj-luke-jovica-ili-kako-je-klinac-koji-je-spavao-u-gepeku-stigao-do-velike-pozornice/67871 |url-status=live }}</ref> His playing style attracted comparisons to [[Darko Pančev]] and [[Radamel Falcao]], who is also his idol.<ref name="TerzaJovic">{{cite web |author=OBRENOVIĆ, Aleksandar |date=11 August 2014 |title=Terzić: Luka Jović je novi Falkao |url=http://www.sportske.net/vest/domaci-fudbal/terzic-luka-jovic-novi-falkao-190342.html |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190605065259/https://www.sportske.net/vest/domaci-fudbal/terzic-luka-jovic-novi-falkao-190342.html |archive-date=5 June 2019 |access-date=12 May 2015}}</ref><ref name="Novosti">{{cite web |author=B. Cvetojevic |date=16 October 2013 |title=Zvezdin biser Jović: Hoću kao Pančev |work=NOVOSTI |url=http://www.novosti.rs/vesti/sport.294.html:459005-Zvezdin-biser-Jovic-Hocu-kao-Pancev |language=sr |access-date=13 May 2015 |archive-date=21 February 2014 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140221175353/http://www.novosti.rs/vesti/sport.294.html:459005-Zvezdin-biser-Jovic-Hocu-kao-Pancev |url-status=live }}</ref>

==Club career==
===Red Star Belgrade===
====Youth====
Jović was offered the chance to play for [[Red Star Belgrade]] in 2005. He played for the Zvezda youth team.

====2013–14 season====
On 28 May 2014, at the age of 16 years, five months and five days, Jović made his professional debut against [[FK Vojvodina]] in [[Novi Sad]], where he broke [[Dejan Stanković]]'s record as the youngest goalscorer in a competitive match in the club's history.<ref name="Blic">{{cite web |author=Todorović, N. |date=28 May 2014 |title=Zvezda je rođena: Luka Jović srušio rekord Dekija Stankovića |url=http://sport.blic.rs/Fudbal/Domaci-fudbal/253382/Zvezda-je-rodjena-Luka-Jovic-srusio-rekord-Dekija-Stankovica-VIDEO |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140722085218/http://sport.blic.rs/Fudbal/Domaci-fudbal/253382/Zvezda-je-rodjena-Luka-Jovic-srusio-rekord-Dekija-Stankovica-VIDEO |archive-date=22 July 2014 |language=sr}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Luka Jović neće otići dok ne napuni 18 |url=http://mondo.rs/a696618/Sport/Fudbal/Luka-Jovic-nece-otici-dok-ne-napuni-18.html |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190810115536/http://mondo.rs/a696618/Sport/Fudbal/Luka-Jovic-nece-otici-dok-ne-napuni-18.html |archive-date=10 August 2019 |access-date=20 March 2016 |work=Mondo Portal}}</ref> He scored the goal only two minutes<ref name="Blic" /> after he was brought on as substitute, and the final score of 3–3 was enough to give Red Star the 2013–14 [[Serbian SuperLiga]] title.

====2014–15 season====
On 18 October 2014, Jović became the youngest player ever to play in [[Eternal derby (Serbia)|Eternal derby]] at the age of 16 years, 9 months and 25 days, breaking the previous record of [[Dejan Milovanović]], who was 17 years and 6 months old at the time.<ref>{{Cite web | url=http://www.mozzartsport.com/vesti/luka-jovic-najmladji-akter-u-istoriji-vecitih-derbija/87162 | title=Luka Jović – najmlađi akter u istoriji večitih derbija! | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160303224245/http://www.mozzartsport.com/vesti/luka-jovic-najmladji-akter-u-istoriji-vecitih-derbija/87162| archive-date=3 March 2016 | website=Mozzart Sport | date=18 October 2014 | language=sr | trans-title=Luka Jović – the youngest player in the history of eternal derbies!}}</ref> Jović missed some crucial chances, but in spring half of the season scored six goals. His first goal of the season came against Vojvodina, in a match where Red Star celebrated its 70th birthday. He then scored against [[FK Spartak Zlatibor Voda|Spartak]], a double against [[FK Borac Čačak|Borac]] and a decisive goal against [[FK Voždovac|Voždovac]], ahead of the Eternal derby clash.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://mojacrvenazvezda.net/107215/2015/04/18/evrogol-i-nastavak-serije-luke-jovica-za-minimalac-zvezde-na-vracaru-pred-derbi/|title=Еврогол и наставак серије Луке Јовића за минималац Звезде на Врачару пред дерби!|author=Александар|date=18 April 2015|work=Moja Crvena Zvezda|access-date=20 March 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190604172217/http://www.mojacrvenazvezda.net/107215/2015/04/18/evrogol-i-nastavak-serije-luke-jovica-za-minimalac-zvezde-na-vracaru-pred-derbi/|archive-date=4 June 2019|url-status=dead}}</ref> He missed the end of the season and the [[2015 FIFA U-20 World Cup]] in [[New Zealand]] due to injury. On 17 May 2015, he signed a three-year contract with Red Star to last until 2018.

====2015–16 season====
From the beginning of the 2015–16 season, Jović started as a first choice in Red Star attack along with [[Hugo Filipe Oliveira|Hugo Vieira]] and scored 3 goals in the first 5 games. He scored again against Voždovac, a winning goal and brought another win to Red Star at [[Obilić Stadium|Stadion na Vračaru]]. He scored another game-winner in Subotica, against Spartak. In November 2015, a [[racketeer]] from Loznica threatened him and his family that if they did not pay money to him, he would "break Jović's legs".<ref name="Blicrek">{{cite web|url=http://www.blic.rs/vesti/hronika/reketas-pretio-da-ce-luki-jovicu-da-polomi-noge/d9cq2rz|author=Miljan Milošević|title=Reketaš pretio da će Luki Joviću da polomi noge|language=sr|date=16 November 2015|access-date=15 December 2015|archive-date=19 December 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151219153040/http://www.blic.rs/vesti/hronika/reketas-pretio-da-ce-luki-jovicu-da-polomi-noge/d9cq2rz|url-status=live}}</ref> A suspect was apprehended immediately afterwards.<ref name="Blicrek" />

===Benfica===
In February 2016, Jović signed with Portuguese champions [[S.L. Benfica|Benfica]] until 2021.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.slbenfica.pt/noticias/detalhedenoticia/tabid/2788/ArticleId/44570/language/pt-PT/.aspx |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160223213443/http://www.slbenfica.pt/noticias/detalhedenoticia/tabid/2788/ArticleId/44570/language/pt-PT/.aspx |url-status=dead |archive-date=23 February 2016 |title=Jović: "Aprender e melhorar todos os dias" |language=pt |trans-title=Jović: "To learn and improve everyday" |date=2 February 2016 |publisher=S.L. Benfica |access-date=2 February 2016}}</ref> On 9 March, he debuted for the club's [[S.L. Benfica|reserve team]] in a 2–2 home draw against [[S.C. Covilhã|Sporting da Covilhã]] in the [[Segunda Liga]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://ligaportugal.pt/oou/jogo/20152016/ledmanligapro/34/9|title=SL Benfica B – SC Covilhã (Jornada 34 Ledman LigaPRO 2015–2016) – Liga Portugal|work=ligaportugal.pt|access-date=20 March 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160409215219/http://www.ligaportugal.pt/oou/jogo/20152016/ledmanligapro/34/9|archive-date=9 April 2016|url-status=dead}}</ref> He debuted for the first team on 20 March, as a substitute, in a 1–0 away victory against [[Boavista F.C.|Boavista]] in the [[2015–16 Primeira Liga|Primeira Liga]].

On 30 January 2017, Jović made his only appearance for the first team when he came on as a substitute in the 81st minute against [[Vitória F.C.|Vitória de Setúbal]].<ref>{{cite web | url = https://www.whoscored.com/Matches/1104173/Live/Portugal-Liga-NOS-2016-2017-Vitoria-de-Setubal-Benfica | title = Match Report | website = whoscored.com | access-date = 16 April 2019 | archive-date = 16 April 2019 | archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20190416130506/https://www.whoscored.com/Matches/1104173/Live/Portugal-Liga-NOS-2016-2017-Vitoria-de-Setubal-Benfica | url-status = live }}</ref>

====Loan to Eintracht Frankfurt====
====2017–18 season====
In June 2017, Jović joined [[Eintracht Frankfurt]] on a two-season loan while his new club secured an option to sign him on a permanent basis.<ref>{{cite news|title=Fix: Eintracht leiht Jovic von Benfica aus|url=https://www.kicker.de/fix_eintracht-leiht-jovic-von-benfica-aus-700477/artikel|access-date=27 June 2017|work=kicker Online|date=27 June 2017|language=de|archive-date=5 June 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190605065325/https://www.kicker.de/news/fussball/bundesliga/startseite/700477/artikel_fix_eintracht-leiht-jovic-von-benfica-aus.html|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|date=27 June 2017|title=Luka Jovic no Eintracht Frankfurt|trans-title=Luka Jovic at Eintracht Frankfurt|url=http://www.slbenfica.pt/30/news/info/Nan6iq1DhUCZJ-LoPcyJbg|language=pt|publisher=S.L. Benfica|access-date=4 July 2017|archive-date=27 June 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170627201540/http://www.slbenfica.pt/30/news/info/Nan6iq1DhUCZJ-LoPcyJbg|url-status=live}}</ref> He made five appearances as they won the [[2017–18 DFB-Pokal]], and scored the only goal of the win at [[FC Schalke 04|Schalke 04]] in the semi-finals on 18 April 2018,<ref>{{cite news |last1=Da Silva |first1=Michael |last2=Harding |first2=Jonathan |title=German Cup: Niko Kovac guides Frankfurt to Berlin for Bayern Munich showdown |url=https://www.dw.com/en/german-cup-niko-kovac-guides-frankfurt-to-berlin-for-bayern-munich-showdown/a-43445046 |access-date=21 October 2018 |publisher=Deutsche Welle |date=18 April 2018 |archive-date=5 June 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190605065236/https://www.dw.com/en/german-cup-niko-kovac-guides-frankfurt-to-berlin-for-bayern-munich-showdown/a-43445046 |url-status=live }}</ref> but was an unused substitute in the [[2018 DFB-Pokal Final|3–1 final win]] over [[FC Bayern Munich|Bayern Munich]].

====2018–19 season====
20-year-old Jović became the youngest player to score five goals in a Bundesliga game when he did so in a 7–1 home win over [[Fortuna Düsseldorf]] on 19 October 2018.<ref>{{cite news |title=Eintracht Frankfurt 7–1 Fortuna Dusseldorf |url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/45922808 |access-date=21 October 2018 |work=BBC Sport |date=19 October 2018 |archive-date=20 October 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181020214017/https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/45922808 |url-status=live }}</ref> On 14 March 2019, he scored the only goal, his seventh for the campaign, in a 1–0 win over [[Inter Milan]] to secure the club's progression to the quarter finals of the [[2018–19 UEFA Europa League|Europa League]]. In doing so, he helped Eintracht become the first German club ever to record eight wins in a single season in the competition.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.bundesliga.com/en/news/Bundesliga/inter-milan-eintracht-frankfurt-live-europa-league-line-ups-stats-icardi-jovic-2969|title=Eintracht Frankfurt through to UEFA Europa League quarter-finals after Luka Jovic chip downs Inter Milan|publisher=Bundesliga|date=14 March 2019|access-date=15 March 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190605232225/https://www.bundesliga.com/en/bundesliga/news/inter-milan-eintracht-frankfurt-live-europa-league-line-ups-stats-icardi-jovic-2969|archive-date=5 June 2019|url-status=live}}</ref>

On 17 April 2019, Eintracht Frankfurt exercised a clause in Jović's contract to make his loan move permanent until 30 June 2023.<ref>{{cite news|date=17 April 2019|title=Eintracht Frankfurt exercise option to purchase Luka Jović|url=https://www.eintracht.de/en/news/article/eintracht-frankfurt-exercise-option-to-purchase-luka-jovic-72250/|publisher=Eintracht Frankfurt|access-date=18 April 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190418222346/https://www.eintracht.de/en/news/article/eintracht-frankfurt-exercise-option-to-purchase-luka-jovic-72250/|archive-date=18 April 2019|url-status=dead}}</ref> In May 2019, he scored in both semi-final legs against [[Chelsea F.C.|Chelsea]], yet Eintracht Frankfurt lost 4–3 on penalties after drawing 1–1 in both matches.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.goal.com/en-sg/news/jovic-other-leagues-in-europe-are-a-much-better-fit-for-me/1qda2gels9heg1d23129x8kenp |title=Jovic: Serie A and the Premier League are the best fits for me |website=Goal.com |date=26 May 2019 |access-date=18 October 2020 |archive-date=18 October 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201018100817/https://www.goal.com/en-sg/news/jovic-other-leagues-in-europe-are-a-much-better-fit-for-me/1qda2gels9heg1d23129x8kenp |url-status=live }}</ref> However, Jović managed to score ten goals in total in the Europa League season.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.bundesliga.com/en/bundesliga/news/why-is-luka-jovic-so-good-eintracht-frankfurt-striker-scoring-goals-left-right-and-centre-3082 |title=Why is Luka Jovic so good? Eintracht Frankfurt striker catches Real Madrid's eye |publisher=Bundesliga |date=2019 |access-date=18 October 2020 |archive-date=18 October 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201018040314/https://www.bundesliga.com/en/bundesliga/news/why-is-luka-jovic-so-good-eintracht-frankfurt-striker-scoring-goals-left-right-and-centre-3082 |url-status=live }}</ref>

===Real Madrid===
====2019–20 season====
[[File:FC RB Salzburg versus Real Madrid (Testspiel, 7. August 2019) 17.jpg|thumb|upright|Jović playing for [[Real Madrid CF|Real Madrid]] in 2019]]

On 4 June 2019, Jović signed for [[Real Madrid CF|Real Madrid]] for a reported €60&nbsp;million, on a six-year contract.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.realmadrid.com/en/news/2019/06/official-announcement-jovi%C4%87|title=Official Announcement: Jović|date=4 June 2019|publisher=Real Madrid CF|access-date=4 June 2019|archive-date=4 June 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190604145135/https://www.realmadrid.com/en/news/2019/06/official-announcement-jovi%25C4%2587|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.standard.co.uk/sport/football/realmadrid/luka-jovic-real-madrid-transfer-confirmed-eintracht-frankfurt-striker-a4145291.html|title=Luka Jovic to Real Madrid transfer confirmed for Eintracht Frankfurt striker|last=Ouzia|first=Malik|date=4 June 2019|work=London Evening Standard|access-date=4 June 2019|archive-date=11 June 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190611051938/https://www.standard.co.uk/sport/football/realmadrid/luka-jovic-real-madrid-transfer-confirmed-eintracht-frankfurt-striker-a4145291.html|url-status=live}}</ref> He made his debut on 17 August 2019, coming in as a substitute in a 3–1 win over [[RC Celta de Vigo|Celta Vigo]].<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.marca.com/en/football/real-madrid/cronica/2019/08/17/5d5833a022601df81e8b4584.html|title=Real Madrid of old resurrected in Balaidos|date=17 August 2019|work=Marca|location=Spain|access-date=17 August 2019|archive-date=14 December 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191214114542/https://www.marca.com/en/football/real-madrid/cronica/2019/08/17/5d5833a022601df81e8b4584.html|url-status=live}}</ref> On 30 October 2019, he scored his first goal for the club in a 5–0 victory over [[CD Leganés]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Real Madrid vs. Leganes – Football Match Summary – October 30, 2019 – ESPN |url=https://www.espn.com/soccer/match?gameId=550508 |publisher=ESPN |access-date=30 October 2019 |archive-date=1 November 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191101215419/https://www.espn.com/soccer/match?gameId=550508 |url-status=live }}</ref>

Jović started both the semi-final and [[2020 Supercopa de España Final|final]] match of [[2019–20 Supercopa de España]] against [[Valencia CF|Valencia]] (made an assist to Modrić's goal) and [[Atlético Madrid]], respectively. Real won the final 4–1 on [[Penalty shootout|penalties]] on 12 January 2020, earning Jović his first trophy as a Real Madrid player.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/51085601|title=Spanish Super Cup: Real Madrid beat Atletico Madrid on penalties|date=12 January 2020|work=BBC Sport|access-date=14 January 2020|archive-date=13 January 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200113072532/https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/51085601|url-status=live}}</ref> During an injury-riddled season, he made 17 appearances during the league season, while scoring two goals, as Real Madrid won the [[2019–20 La Liga]] title.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.marca.com/en/football/real-madrid/2020/07/17/5f10db2146163f3c2c8b45d7.html|title=Real Madrid win the longest LaLiga Santander season|date=17 July 2020|access-date=17 July 2020|website=Marca|location=Spain|archive-date=17 July 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200717031601/https://www.marca.com/en/football/real-madrid/2020/07/17/5f10db2146163f3c2c8b45d7.html|url-status=live}}</ref>

====Loan to Eintracht Frankfurt ====
On 14 January 2021, Jović was loaned back to his former club [[Eintracht Frankfurt]] until the end of the 2020–21 season.<ref>{{cite news|title=Leihe bis Saisonende|url=https://profis.eintracht.de/news/leihe-bis-saisonende-130254|access-date=14 January 2021|publisher=profis.eintracht.de|language=de|archive-date=26 January 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210126122930/https://profis.eintracht.de/news/leihe-bis-saisonende-130254/|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|title=Official Announcement: Jović|url=https://www.realmadrid.com/en/news/2021/01/14/official-announcement-jovi%C4%87|access-date=14 January 2021|publisher=Real Madric CF|archive-date=14 January 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210114142535/https://www.realmadrid.com/en/news/2021/01/14/official-announcement-jovi%C4%87|url-status=live}}</ref> On 17 January, in his first match back with his former club, Jović came off the bench and scored two goals within half an hour as Frankfurt defeated [[FC Schalke 04|Schalke]] 3–1.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.marca.com/en/football/international-football/eintrach-vs-schalke-04/cronica/2021/01/17/60048f9522601db9258b460e.html|title=Luka Jovic scores two goals in 28 minutes on Frankfurt return!|website=Marca|date=17 January 2021|access-date=19 January 2021|archive-date=19 January 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210119120910/https://www.marca.com/en/football/international-football/eintrach-vs-schalke-04/cronica/2021/01/17/60048f9522601db9258b460e.html|url-status=live}}</ref>

===Fiorentina===
On 8 July 2022, [[Serie A]] club [[ACF Fiorentina|Fiorentina]] announced the signing of Jović on a free transfer.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Jovic signs for Fiorentina |url=http://www.acffiorentina.com/en/news/all/news-men-first-team/2022-07-08/jovic-signs-for-fiorentina |access-date=8 July 2022 |website=ACF Fiorentina |archive-date=9 July 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220709030704/https://www.acffiorentina.com/en/news/all/news-men-first-team/2022-07-08/jovic-signs-for-fiorentina |url-status=dead }}</ref> In his first and only season in Florence, he scored 13 goals in 50 games.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://footballpark.com/football-blogs/from-stardom-to-obscurity-the-luka-jovic-story|title=From Stardom to Obscurity : The Luka Jovic Story|website=footballpark.com|access-date=13 January 2025|archive-date=13 January 2025|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250113153935/https://footballpark.com/football-blogs/from-stardom-to-obscurity-the-luka-jovic-story|url-status=live}}</ref>

=== AC Milan ===
On 1 September 2023, Jović signed for [[AC Milan]] on a season-long contract.<ref>{{Cite web |title=OFFICIAL STATEMENT: LUKA JOVIĆ |url=http://www.acmilan.com/en/news/articles/media/2023-09-01/official-statement-luka-jovic |access-date=2023-09-01 |website=AC Milan |language=en |archive-date=1 September 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230901184258/https://www.acmilan.com/en/news/articles/media/2023-09-01/official-statement-luka-jovic |url-status=live }}</ref> Three months later, on 2 December 2023, Jović scored his first goal for Milan in a 3–1 home win against [[Frosinone Calcio|Frosinone]].<ref>{{cite web | url=https://www.legaseriea.it/en/match/2023-24aunicouni14milfro | title=Milan Vs Frosinone | access-date=3 December 2023 | archive-date=8 July 2023 | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230708083820/https://www.legaseriea.it/en/match/2023-24aunicouni14milfro | url-status=live }}</ref>

He was cut from Milan's 2024–25 UEFA Champions League squad,<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://football-italia.net/milan-cut-jovic-champions-league-squad/|title=Milan cut Jovic from Champions League squad list|date=3 September 2024|website=football-italia.net|access-date=13 January 2025|archive-date=13 January 2025|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250113154916/https://football-italia.net/milan-cut-jovic-champions-league-squad/|url-status=live}}</ref> leaving his future in doubt.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://sempremilan.com/longo-milan-willing-free-transfer-striker-outcast|title=Longo: Milan willing to allow free transfer as striker outcast lacks suitors|date=11 January 2025|website=SempreMilan|access-date=13 January 2025|archive-date=13 January 2025|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250113154917/https://sempremilan.com/longo-milan-willing-free-transfer-striker-outcast|url-status=live}}</ref> On 29 June 2025, Milan confirmed that Jovic was leaving the club on a free transfer upon the expiry of his contract.<ref>{{Cite tweet | user=acmilan | number=1939323731605647395 | title=Thank you, Luka! 🇷🇸  We wish you all the best for the next stage of your career 😊}}</ref>

=== AEK Athens ===
On 5 August 2025, Jović joined [[Super League Greece|Greek]] club [[AEK Athens F.C.|AEK Athens]] on a free transfer, signing a two-year deal.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.aekfc.gr/newsdetails/stin-aek-o-louka-giovits-132828.htm?lang=en&path=-1609672754|title=Luka Jović joins AEK FC!|date=5 August 2025|website=aekfc.gr|location=Online|access-date=5 August 2025|archive-date=5 August 2025|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250805092953/https://www.aekfc.gr/newsdetails/stin-aek-o-louka-giovits-132828.htm?lang=en&path=-1609672754|url-status=live}}</ref> He scored on his debut against [[Aris Limassol FC|Aris Limassol]], which helped secure qualification to the league phase of the [[UEFA Conference League]]. On 5 October 2025, he came off the bench to score his first league goal in a 3–2 comeback win against [[A.E. Kifisia F.C.|Kifisia]]. A month later, on 30 November, he scored his first hat trick for AEK in their 3–2 away win in the [[Athenian derby]], against [[Panathinaikos F.C.|Panathinaikos]].

On 18 January 2026, he became the first player in the History of Greek football to score 4 goals against [[Panathinaikos F.C.|Panathinaikos]] in a derby in AEK's 4–0 triumph over their local rivals. (The jersey he wore in that match is now in the AEK Museum.)<ref>{{Cite web |title=AEK 4:0 Panatinaikos - Super League 2025/2026 Live |url=https://www.mozzartsport.com/fudbal/vesti/luka-jovic-vec-zavrsio-u-aekov-muzeju-foto/534512 |access-date=12 May 2026 |archive-date=17 May 2026 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260517183806/https://www.mozzartsport.com/fudbal/vesti/luka-jovic-vec-zavrsio-u-aekov-muzeju-foto/534512 |url-status=live }}</ref> After some important goals, double against [[Atromitos F.C.|Atromitos]], [[Levadiakos F.C.|Levadiakos]] and decisive like a winner against [[OFI Crete F.C.|OFI]] and vs [[Asteras Tripolis F.C.|Asteras Tripolis]], he scored a crucial five minute brace again vs [[Atromitos F.C.|Atromitos]] in a 2–2 draw and was named Player of the Month for March.<ref name="slgr_stoiximan-player-of-the-month-tou">{{cite web |date=6 April 2026 |title=Stoiximan Player of the Month του Μαρτίου ο Λούκα Γιόβιτς |url=https://www.slgr.gr/el/article/stoiximan-player-of-the-month-tou/}}</ref>

He also led AEK to the 3rd place in [[UEFA Conference League]] Phase and their first European Quarterfinal in the 21st Century, as they progressed past Celje to reach the Quarterfinals of the [[UEFA Conference League]] [[2025–26 UEFA Conference League|2025–26]] .<ref>{{Cite web|title=AEK - Conference League|url=https://www.sportal.blic.rs/prica/luka-jovic-heroj-aek-otisao-u-najboljih-osam-na-sokantan-nacin-2025121816023651797|access-date=12 May 2026|archive-date=25 January 2026|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260125002540/https://sportal.blic.rs/prica/luka-jovic-heroj-aek-otisao-u-najboljih-osam-na-sokantan-nacin-2025121816023651797|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=AEK - Conference League|url=https://sportal.blic.rs/prica/aek-razbio-celje-jovic-asistirao-gacinovic-dao-gol-kristal-palas-se-obrukao-2026031217301939038|access-date=12 May 2026|archive-date=19 May 2026|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260519044426/https://sportal.blic.rs/prica/aek-razbio-celje-jovic-asistirao-gacinovic-dao-gol-kristal-palas-se-obrukao-2026031217301939038|url-status=live}}</ref>

On 10 May, in the 72nd minute, he set up [[Zini (footballer)|Zini]] for the equaliser, and in stoppage time, produced an assist for [[João Mário (footballer, born January 1993)|João Mário]]'s 93rd-minute title-winning goal against [[Panathinaikos F.C.|Panathinaikos]]<ref>{{Cite web|title=AEK 2:1 Panatinaikos|url=https://sportal.blic.rs/prica/aek-je-sampion-grcke-jovic-asistencijom-u-nadoknadi-doneo-pehar-zuto-crnima-2026051018312975754|access-date=12 May 2026|archive-date=12 June 2026|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260612021905/https://sportal.blic.rs/prica/aek-je-sampion-grcke-jovic-asistencijom-u-nadoknadi-doneo-pehar-zuto-crnima-2026051018312975754|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=AEK 2:1 Panatinaikos|url=https://www.mozzartsport.com/fudbal/vesti/aek-i-nikolic-sampioni-grcke-delovalo-je-strasno-zavrsilo-se-najslae-moguce/543480}}</ref>

==International career==
===Youth===
====2013–14: Hat-trick and 2014 European U19 Championship====
On 11 December 2013, Jović scored a [[hat-trick]] for [[Serbia national under-17 football team|Serbia U-17]] in a 4–1 win against [[Croatia national under-17 football team|Croatia U-17]].<ref name="Mozzart1">{{cite web |date=11 December 2013 |title=Luka Jović terorisao Hrvate u Pazovi! |url=http://www.mozzartsport.com/vesti/luka-jovic-terorisao-hrvate-u-pazovi/66885 |language=sr |access-date=9 July 2014 |archive-date=20 January 2015 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150120152253/http://www.mozzartsport.com/vesti/luka-jovic-terorisao-hrvate-u-pazovi/66885 |url-status=live }}</ref> In July 2014, he was called up by youth coach [[Veljko Paunović]] to [[Serbia national under-19 football team|Serbia's U-19]] [[2014 UEFA European Under-19 Championship squads#Serbia|squad]] for the [[2014 UEFA European Under-19 Championship]].<ref>{{cite news |date=8 July 2014 |title=Novosti: Na Paunovićevom spisku po četiri igrača Zvezde, Vojvodine i OFK Beograda, tri Partizana... |url=http://novosti.rs/vesti/sport.294.html:499882-Na-Paunovicevom-spisku-po-cetiri-igraca-Zvezde-Vojvodine-i-OFK-Beograda-tri-Partizana |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190809132743/http://www.novosti.rs/vesti/sport.294.html:499882-Na-Paunovicevom-spisku-po-cetiri-igraca-Zvezde-Vojvodine-i-OFK-Beograda-tri-Partizana |archive-date=9 August 2019 |website=Novosti |language=sr}}</ref>

===Senior===
====2018–19: Debut, first FIFA World Cup, and first goal====
In May 2018, Jović was named in [[Serbia national football team|Serbia]]'s preliminary squad for the [[2018 FIFA World Cup|FIFA World Cup]] in Russia.<ref>{{cite news |url=http://www.fss.rs/index.php?id=2021&aid=13898 |title=Један тим, срцем свим – Младен Крстајић одабрао |trans-title=One team, with all their hearts – Mladen Krstajić selects |website=Football Association of Serbia |publisher=[[Football Association of Serbia]] |date=24 May 2018 |access-date=24 May 2018 |language=sr |archive-date=7 June 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190607190555/http://www.fss.rs/index.php?id=2021&aid=13898 |url-status=live }}</ref> On 4 June, he made his international debut in a friendly match against [[Chile national football team|Chile]], coming on as a substitute for [[Aleksandar Mitrović]] in the 84th minute.<ref>{{Cite news|title=Митровић: Не треба драмити после пораза од Чилеа! Јовић: Испунио ми се сан|url=https://www.zurnal.rs/scc/clanak/64761/%D0%9C%D0%B8%D1%82%D1%80%D0%BE%D0%B2%D0%B8%D1%9B-%D0%9D%D0%B5-%D1%82%D1%80%D0%B5%D0%B1%D0%B0-%D0%B4%D1%80%D0%B0%D0%BC%D0%B8%D1%82%D0%B8-%D0%BF%D0%BE%D1%81%D0%BB%D0%B5-%D0%BF%D0%BE%D1%80%D0%B0%D0%B7%D0%B0-%D0%BE%D0%B4-%D0%A7%D0%B8%D0%BB%D0%B5%D0%B0-%D0%88%D0%BE%D0%B2%D0%B8%D1%9B-%D0%98%D1%81%D0%BF%D1%83%D0%BD%D0%B8%D0%BE-%D0%BC%D0%B8-%D1%81%D0%B5-%D1%81%D0%B0%D0%BD|quote=Njega je u drugom poluvremenu zamenio debitant u "A" selekciji Luka Jović, koji je istakao da je presrećan zbog debija, ali da žali zbog poraza.|script-quote=sr:Митровић: Не треба драмити после пораза од Чилеа! Јовић: Испунио ми се сан|trans-quote=He [Mitrović] was replaced in the second half by debutant Luka Jović, who pointed out that he was overjoyed about his debut, but regretted the defeat.|website=[[Sportski žurnal]]|date=5 June 2018|language=sr|archive-date=26 March 2024|access-date=26 March 2024|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240326115028/https://www.zurnal.rs/scc/clanak/64761/%D0%9C%D0%B8%D1%82%D1%80%D0%BE%D0%B2%D0%B8%D1%9B-%D0%9D%D0%B5-%D1%82%D1%80%D0%B5%D0%B1%D0%B0-%D0%B4%D1%80%D0%B0%D0%BC%D0%B8%D1%82%D0%B8-%D0%BF%D0%BE%D1%81%D0%BB%D0%B5-%D0%BF%D0%BE%D1%80%D0%B0%D0%B7%D0%B0-%D0%BE%D0%B4-%D0%A7%D0%B8%D0%BB%D0%B5%D0%B0-%D0%88%D0%BE%D0%B2%D0%B8%D1%9B-%D0%98%D1%81%D0%BF%D1%83%D0%BD%D0%B8%D0%BE-%D0%BC%D0%B8-%D1%81%D0%B5-%D1%81%D0%B0%D0%BD|url-status=live}}</ref>

Later in June, Jović was included in the [[2018 FIFA World Cup squads#Serbia|final 23-man squad]] for the [[2018 FIFA World Cup]],<ref>{{Cite web | url=https://www.reuters.com/article/us-soccer-worldcup-srb-squad/soccer-krstajic-names-serbias-final-23-man-world-cup-squad-idUSKCN1IX5O2 | title=Soccer: Krstajic names Serbia's final 23-man World Cup squad | work=Reuters | date=1 June 2018 | access-date=6 June 2018 | archive-date=27 March 2023 | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230327152744/https://www.reuters.com/article/us-soccer-worldcup-srb-squad/soccer-krstajic-names-serbias-final-23-man-world-cup-squad-idUSKCN1IX5O2 | url-status=live }}</ref> where he appeared as a late substitute against [[Brazil national football team|Brazil]].<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.nytimes.com/2018/06/27/sports/world-cup/brazil-vs-serbia.html|title=World Cup: Brazil cruises into next round with easy victory|newspaper=The New York Times|author=Andrew Das|date=27 June 2018|access-date=27 June 2018|archive-date=5 May 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190505092244/https://www.nytimes.com/2018/06/27/sports/world-cup/brazil-vs-serbia.html|url-status=live}}</ref>

On 20 March 2019, Jović scored his debut goal for the national team in a friendly against [[Germany national football team|Germany]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/47644286|title=Germany 1 Serbia 1|date=20 March 2019|work=BBC Sport|access-date=28 March 2019|archive-date=2 April 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190402222230/https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/47644286|url-status=live}}</ref>

====2022–24: Second FIFA World Cup and first Euro====
In November 2022 he was selected in Serbia's squad for the [[2022 FIFA World Cup]] in Qatar.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://fss.rs/en/head-coach-dragan-stojkovic-announces-the-list-of-players-for-the-fifa-world-cup-2022-in-qatar/ |title=Head-coach Dragan Stojković announces the list of players for the FIFA World Cup 2022 in Qatar |publisher=[[Football Association of Serbia]] |date=11 November 2022 |access-date=11 November 2022 |archive-date=23 June 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230623001754/https://fss.rs/en/head-coach-dragan-stojkovic-announces-the-list-of-players-for-the-fifa-world-cup-2022-in-qatar/ |url-status=live }}</ref> He played in group stage matches against [[Cameroon national football team|Cameroon]]<ref>{{Cite news|title=World Cup 2022 - Cameroon 3-3 Serbia: Vincent Aboubakar and Eric Maxim Choupo-Moting goals complete stunning comeback|url=https://www.skysports.com/football/cameroon-vs-serbia/report/462988#:~:text=World%20Cup%202022%20%2D%20Cameroon%203,Moting%20goals%20complete%20stunning%20comeback&text=Cameroon%20kept%20alive%20their%20faint,with%20Serbia%20in%20Al%2DWakrah.|website=[[Sky Sports]]|date=28 November 2022|archive-date=30 November 2022|access-date=7 December 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221130095043/https://www.skysports.com/football/cameroon-vs-serbia/report/462988#:~:text=World%20Cup%202022%20%2D%20Cameroon%203,Moting%20goals%20complete%20stunning%20comeback&text=Cameroon%20kept%20alive%20their%20faint,with%20Serbia%20in%20Al%2DWakrah.|url-status=live}}</ref> and [[Switzerland national football team|Switzerland]].<ref>{{cite news|title=Switzerland advance and Serbia go out as Freuler finish settles stormy contest|url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/2022/dec/02/serbia-switzerland-world-cup-group-g-match-report|newspaper=[[The Guardian]]|location=London|date=2 December 2022|access-date=7 December 2022|archive-date=7 December 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221207020716/https://www.theguardian.com/football/2022/dec/02/serbia-switzerland-world-cup-group-g-match-report|url-status=live}}</ref> Serbia finished fourth in the group.<ref>{{Cite news|first=Nicholas|last=Mendola|title=World Cup 2022 Group G: Brazil, Serbia, Cameroon, Switzerland schedule, fixtures, rankings|url=https://soccer.nbcsports.com/2022/12/02/world-cup-2022-group-g-brazil-serbia-cameroon-switzerland-rankings-table-standings/|newspaper=[[NBC Sports]]|location=Lusail|date=2 December 2022|access-date=7 December 2022|archive-date=7 December 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221207152152/https://soccer.nbcsports.com/2022/12/02/world-cup-2022-group-g-brazil-serbia-cameroon-switzerland-rankings-table-standings/|url-status=live}}</ref>

Jović was part of the Serbia squad for [[UEFA Euro 2024]]. In the team's opening match of the tournament against [[England national football team|England]], he came on as a substitute for [[Saša Lukić]] in the 61st minute of the 1–0 loss.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/live/cz992dxd4xwt#Line-ups|title=Serbia 0-1 England LIVE: UEFA Euro 2024 - score, updates & reaction|website=BBC Sport|access-date=17 June 2024|archive-date=17 June 2024|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240617013156/https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/live/cz992dxd4xwt#Line-ups|url-status=live}}</ref> Jović appeared in the second match against [[Slovenia national football team|Slovenia]], where he scored a [[last-minute goal]] that tied the result at 1–1. He also appeared in the third match, against [[Denmark national football team|Denmark]]. Serbia finished fourth in the group.

==Personal life==
When Jović was 10 years old, his older sister survived [[leukaemia]]. He stated that period had "left a mark on their lives" and had motivated him to become a "fighter like her".<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.blic.rs/zabava/luka-jovic-zivotna-prica-sestra-leukemija/5sbrljq|title="TO MI JE OBELEŽILO ŽIVOT" Sestra Luke Jovića je pobedila LEUKEMIJU, potresna priča kida dušu, a kad čujete njegovu poruku APLAUDIRAĆETE MU|access-date=11 February 2020|date=3 December 2019|author=J. K.|work=[[Blic]]|language=sr|archive-date=3 May 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200503223643/https://www.blic.rs/zabava/luka-jovic-zivotna-prica-sestra-leukemija/5sbrljq|url-status=live}}</ref>

On 25 February 2019, Jović became a father of a baby boy, David, with his former girlfriend Anđela Manitašević, with whom he had split up in 2016.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.kurir.rs/sport/fudbal/3210683/mladi-napadac-postao-otac-luka-jovic-dobio-sina|title=MLADI NAPADAČ POSTAO OTAC: Luka Jović dobio sina!|work=[[Kurir]]|author=M. B.|date=24 February 2019|access-date=11 February 2020|language=sr|archive-date=10 October 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201010200341/https://www.kurir.rs/sport/fudbal/3210683/mladi-napadac-postao-otac-luka-jovic-dobio-sina|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |author=J.
